question: How is the lord equal to all beings yet especially present to devotees?
premises: i am equal among all beings
to me none is hateful nor dear
those who worship me with devotion are in me
and i too am in them
inference: equality is not indifference; devotion establishes mutual indwelling
uncertainties: fused sandhi surfaces kept as single rows
plain_english: I am equal among all beings; to me none is hateful, none dear. But those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I too am in them.
